SELECT b.bom_id, b.parent_item_id, b.component_item_id, b.required_qty, b.created_at, b.updated_at,
parent_item.item_code AS parent_item_code,
parent_item.item_name AS parent_item_name,
component_item.item_code AS component_item_code,
component_item.item_name AS component_item_name,
component_item.unit AS component_unit
FROM bom b
JOIN item parent_item ON parent_item.item_id = b.parent_item_id
JOIN item component_item ON component_item.item_id = b.component_item_id
ORDER BY parent_item.item_code, component_item.item_code

SELECT b.bom_id, b.parent_item_id, b.component_item_id, b.required_qty, b.created_at, b.updated_at,
parent_item.item_code AS parent_item_code,
parent_item.item_name AS parent_item_name,
component_item.item_code AS component_item_code,
component_item.item_name AS component_item_name,
component_item.unit AS component_unit
FROM bom b
JOIN item parent_item ON parent_item.item_id = b.parent_item_id
JOIN item component_item ON component_item.item_id = b.component_item_id
WHERE b.parent_item_id = #{parentItemId}
ORDER BY component_item.item_code
